titleZh: 单元复习:放假前的最后一班
goalZh: 综合运用本单元的天气、穿衣和假期计划,和顾客、同事闲聊
canDoZh: 能和顾客、同事自然地聊天气、穿衣和假期计划,完成一段完整的闲聊

newItems.noteZh: The streets are slippery.(路很滑。)sl 连在一起读,重音在前 SLIP-。
Christmas 的 t 不发音;不确定对方过不过圣诞时,美国人常说 Happy holidays!。

lines.speaker: regular
lines.text: It's snowing! And the streets are really slippery.
lines.zh: (寒假前磊的最后一班,老顾客进门)下雪了!路可滑了。

lines.speaker: regular
lines.text: Thanks. Is it going to snow all night?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Let me see... No, it's going to stop at eight.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: But it's going to get really cold.

lines.speaker: regular
lines.text: Great. A large hot coffee, please!
lines.zh: 好吧。来一杯大杯热咖啡!

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hi! Are you going to go home for the holidays?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: No, I'm going to stay here. In January, I'm going to go to LA.
lines.zh: 不回,我留在这儿。一月我要去洛杉矶。

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Nice! It's warm and sunny there.
lines.zh: 真好!那儿又暖和又晴朗。

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: OK, guys. Today is our last day this semester.
lines.zh: 好了,各位。今天是这学期最后一天。

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: No work for a month! See you in January.
lines.zh: 一个月不用上班!一月见。

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Put on your hats and gloves. The streets are slippery!

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: And come to my concerts! My band is going to play downtown.
lines.zh: 还有,来看我的演出!我的乐队要在市中心演几场。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Cool! Merry Christmas, Laura! Happy holidays, Marcus!
lines.zh: 酷!圣诞快乐,劳拉!节日快乐,马库斯!

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Happy holidays, Lei! Good job this semester.
lines.zh: 节日快乐,磊!这学期干得不错。

grammar.titleZh: 第 9 单元小结:天气、穿衣和计划
grammar.bodyZh: ① 天气用 it:It's snowing. / It's cold and windy.;问天气 What's the weather like?。② 温度:It's 30 degrees. / It's below zero.;问程度 How cold is it?。③ be going to:说计划 I'm going to stay here.,也说“看样子要……”It's going to snow.。④ get + 形容词表示变化:It gets dark at 4:30. / It's going to get cold.。⑤ wear 是“穿着”,put on 是“穿上”:Put on your hat!。发音:闲聊时抱怨天气用降调(Terrible weather! ↘),一般疑问句用升调(Is it going to snow? ↗)。

examples.text: It's snowing, and the streets are slippery.
Is it going to snow all night? — No, it's going to stop at eight.
examples.zh: 雪会下一整夜吗?——不会,八点就停。

examples.text: Put on your hat and gloves. It's freezing!
examples.zh: 戴好帽子和手套,冷得要命!
